body.demonstration_purpose: Demonstrates why broad district weather alerts fail local decision-makers: 3 nearby locations with identical 160mm rainfall exhibit completely divergent hazard outcomes based on local terrain physics.

comparisons.location_name: Location A: Lonavala Civic Center / Ryewood
comparisons.soil_type: Permeable urban garden loam on flat plateau
comparisons.verdict: SAFE & STABLE. Gently sloping flat plateau (6.5°) rapidly drains surface runoff without gravitational shear.
comparisons.verdict_mr: सुरक्षित: सपाट पठारी भाग (६.५°) असल्याने दरड किंवा पुराचा धोका नाही.

comparisons.location_name: Location B: Amrutanjan Bridge Expressway Cutting
comparisons.soil_type: Steep fractured basalt overburden with road-cut toe
comparisons.verdict: CRITICAL LANDSLIDE DANGER. Identical rain on 36.5° steep engineered cut slope with 86% saturated basalt mantle triggers critical shear failure.
comparisons.verdict_mr: अतिधोका (दरड): ३६.५° तीव्र उतार आणि ८६% संपृक्त मातीमुळे दगडी दरड कोसळण्याची दाट शक्यता.

comparisons.location_name: Location C: Bhushi Dam Downstream Cascade
comparisons.soil_type: Narrow gorge convergence channel receiving 4.8 km² upstream flow
comparisons.verdict: HIGH FLASH-SURGE DANGER. Upstream catchment convergence funnels intense runoff into a sudden hydraulic surge at the overflow weir.
comparisons.verdict_mr: अतिधोका (पाण्याचा लोंढा): वरच्या पाणलोटातून येणारा पाण्याचा अचानक मोठा लोंढा पर्यटकांना वाहून नेऊ शकतो.
